summary: MEMPOOL_POINT_IN_TIME_PROOF_INSUFFICIENT_WAIT. Official versioned mempool source proves an open-source, credential-free current fee-state surface with identifiable routes, payload fields, units, configurable polling and an unsynchronized-service failure state. It does not prove a source observation timestamp, immutable snapshot identity, hosted refresh or revision guarantees, retention or replay semantics, continuity guarantees, payload-data reuse rights, or a versioned schema-drift protocol. A Manager receipt timestamp cannot be substituted for the absent source observation clock. The evidence therefore cannot yet support a causally sealed point-in-time source contract. CFTC priority, historical deduplication, R1/R2 isolation, the sole Cloud Ops clock and Server Canonical sole-writer authority remain unchanged. Immediate PnL and drawdown effects are zero; predictive and economic value remain MISSING_PROOF.

checks.evidence: Only first-party versioned artifacts were used: the [official mempool repository](https://github.com/mempool/mempool), [software license](https://github.com/mempool/mempool/blob/master/LICENSE), [fee implementation](https://github.com/mempool/mempool/blob/master/backend/src/api/fee-api.ts), [route definitions](https://github.com/mempool/mempool/blob/master/backend/src/api/bitcoin/bitcoin.routes.ts), [payload interfaces](https://github.com/mempool/mempool/blob/master/backend/src/mempool.interfaces.ts), [configuration](https://github.com/mempool/mempool/blob/master/backend/src/config.ts) and [mempool state implementation](https://github.com/mempool/mempool/blob/master/backend/src/api/mempool.ts). No endpoint or dataset was called.

checks.name: POINT_IN_TIME_FIELD_AND_CLOCK_CONTRACT_ASSESSMENT
checks.evidence: The official fee source defines the recommended-fee field family and projected-block structural fields and derives fee-rate outputs from current cached state. The returned fee payload has no source observation timestamp, sequence, immutable snapshot identifier or explicit as-of clock. A downstream received_at value would prove receipt only, not when the source state was observed.

checks.name: REVISION_RETENTION_AND_REPLAY_ASSESSMENT
checks.evidence: First-party source establishes mutable current-state computation and configurable polling, but no versioned contract was found for hosted refresh cadence, retrospective revision, historical retention, replay, or reconstruction of an earlier response.

checks.name: CONTINUITY_GAP_AND_SCHEMA_DRIFT_ASSESSMENT
checks.evidence: The route fails closed when the mempool is not synchronized, which is useful absence evidence. The listed official artifacts do not establish end-to-end continuity, missed-snapshot recovery, hosted availability, immutable response schemas, or a versioned schema-drift notification contract.

checks.name: PROVENANCE_LICENSE_AND_CREDENTIAL_ASSESSMENT
checks.evidence: Repository provenance and AGPL-3.0-or-later software licensing are explicit, and the inspected GET route has no source-level credential middleware. The software license does not itself establish reuse rights for hosted response data, and no frozen hosted access or continuity commitment was proven.

checks.name: SINGLE_CLOCK_ARCHITECTURE_AND_OPERATING_COST_ASSESSMENT
checks.evidence: A future bounded fetch could be invoked by the existing sole Cloud Ops cycle and sealed with request and receipt clocks, but that would not repair the missing source observation clock. Self-hosting is technically documented but would add node, database and operational burden that has not been justified by predictive or economic evidence.

checks.name: PRIORITY_AND_DEDUPLICATION_GUARDS
checks.evidence: The sealed repository inputs preserve CFTC as the public-source priority and retain the historical mechanism-deduplication guard. No R1, R2, CFTC, carry or post-shock contract was replaced, ranked by outcome, or recomputed.

checks.name: PERFORMANCE_DRAWDOWN_AND_CLAIM_BOUNDARY
checks.evidence: No market value, historical observation, factor, return, PnL or drawdown was retrieved or calculated. Immediate PnL and drawdown effects are zero; causality, predictive value and economic value remain MISSING_PROOF.

checks.name: FORBIDDEN_ACTION_BOUNDARY
checks.evidence: No live endpoint, repository clone, dataset download, mempool execution, third-party evidence, file or state write, source activation, hypothesis, candidate, OOS action, Research MCP write, clock change, canonical mutation or Trading action occurred.

checks.name: MEMPOOL_SOURCE_DISPOSITION
checks.evidence: MEMPOOL_POINT_IN_TIME_PROOF_INSUFFICIENT_WAIT follows because the source is not proven intrinsically unsuitable, but the exact point-in-time and continuity contract required for safe integration is absent from the permitted official evidence.

uncertainty: MISSING_PROOF: source-produced observation timestamp or immutable snapshot identity.
MISSING_PROOF: hosted refresh cadence, revision policy, retention and replay behavior.
MISSING_PROOF: continuity guarantees, missed-snapshot recovery and versioned schema-drift handling.
MISSING_PROOF: hosted response-data reuse rights and long-term credential-free access.
MISSING_PROOF: predictive usefulness, causality, incremental value, PnL and drawdown effects.
MISSING_PROOF: operating-cost justification for any self-hosted alternative.
recommended_next_action: Freeze one later READ_ONLY proof task limited to an official versioned mempool API or source-contract artifact that explicitly binds response observation-time semantics, immutable snapshot or sequence identity, schema version, refresh and revision behavior, retention or explicit non-retention, continuity and gap states, and hosted payload reuse and credential terms. Preserve CFTC priority and do not implement or activate a source unless that proof closes.
